expected_html:
flowchart TD
    Start(("使用者輸入 https://erp.example.com/ApiTokens<br/>Enter")) --> DnsResolve

    DnsResolve["DNS 解析<br/>(timeout 5s)"] -->|"OK"| TlsHandshake
    DnsResolve -->|"Fail"| ErrDns(("NET::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED"))

    TlsHandshake["TLS 1.3 握手<br/>(timeout 10s; SNI=erp.example.com)"] -->|"OK"| HttpReq
    TlsHandshake -->|"Fail"| ErrTls(("NET::ERR_CERT_*"))

    HttpReq["HTTP GET /ApiTokens<br/>Cookie: .AspNetCore.Cookies (if exists)"] --> ServerCheckCookie

    subgraph Server_Init["Server: ASP.NET Core Pipeline"]
        ServerCheckCookie{"Cookie Authentication<br/>有效?"}
        AuthGuard["AuthGuard middleware<br/>檢查 Session"]
        FetchUserData["IndexModel.OnGetAsync<br/>tokenAppService.ListMyTokens"]
        ServerRender["Razor 渲染 HTML<br/>+ AntiForgery hidden input<br/>+ CSP nonce 注入"]
        ServerRedirect["302 → /Login?returnUrl=/ApiTokens"]
    end

    ServerCheckCookie -->|"是"| AuthGuard
    ServerCheckCookie -->|"否或過期"| ServerRedirect
    ServerRedirect --> Done301(("瀏覽器導向 /Login（流程結束）"))
    AuthGuard --> FetchUserData
    FetchUserData --> ServerRender
    ServerRender --> RecvHtml["瀏覽器接收 HTML response<br/>(< 80KB gzipped, FRONTEND §11.1)"]

    RecvHtml --> ParallelDownload

    subgraph Parallel_Resources["Parallel 資源下載（fork 並行）"]
        DownloadCss["GET /css/site.css<br/>(Tailwind 編譯，~30KB gzipped)"]
        DownloadAlpine["GET cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs@3.14.9<br/>(SRI: sha384-..., ~15KB gzipped)"]
        DownloadFonts["GET fonts.googleapis.com/css?Inter+Noto+JetBrains<br/>(preconnect, font-display: swap)"]
    end

    RecvHtml -.->|"fork"| DownloadCss
    RecvHtml -.->|"fork"| DownloadAlpine
    RecvHtml -.->|"fork"| DownloadFonts

    DownloadCss --> JoinResources
    DownloadAlpine --> SriCheck
    DownloadFonts --> JoinResources

    SriCheck{"Alpine SRI hash<br/>match?"} -->|"是"| JoinResources
    SriCheck -->|"否（CDN tampering）"| ErrSri(("Browser 拒絕載入<br/>+ Console error"))
    ErrSri --> FallbackAlpine{"備援 self-host?"}
    FallbackAlpine -->|"有"| RetryLocal["GET /lib/alpine.min.js (self-host)"]
    FallbackAlpine -->|"無"| ErrFatal(("Alpine 不可用 → 表單仍可 server-side 提交"))
    RetryLocal --> JoinResources

    JoinResources["[join] 所有資源就緒"] --> ParseDom

    ParseDom["瀏覽器解析 DOM"] --> AlpineStart
    AlpineStart["Alpine.start()<br/>初始化所有 x-data 元件"] --> InitComponents

    subgraph Init_Alpine["Alpine 元件初始化"]
        InitTokenModal["tokenCreateModal()<br/>{ description, isSubmitting, error }"]
        InitRevokeModal["revokeConfirmModal()<br/>{ tokenId, isOpen, isLoading }"]
        InitToastStore["Alpine.store('toast', {...})"]
        InitFetchInterceptor["AuthFetchInterceptor 註冊<br/>讀 csrfToken from hidden input"]
        InitCopyButton["copyButton(text)（P03 才會出現）"]
    end

    InitComponents -->|"fork"| InitTokenModal
    InitComponents -->|"fork"| InitRevokeModal
    InitComponents -->|"fork"| InitToastStore
    InitComponents -->|"fork"| InitFetchInterceptor

    InitTokenModal --> Ready
    InitRevokeModal --> Ready
    InitToastStore --> Ready
    InitFetchInterceptor --> Ready

    Ready["[join] UI 互動就緒<br/>(LCP target < 2.5s, INP target < 200ms)"] --> Renderable
    Renderable(("使用者可開始操作（建立 / 撤銷 / 查看）"))

    %% Retry/timeout edge cases
    DnsResolve -.->|"timeout 5s"| Retry1["Browser auto-retry once"]
    Retry1 --> DnsResolve
    TlsHandshake -.->|"timeout 10s"| Retry2["Browser auto-retry once"]
    Retry2 --> TlsHandshake
    DownloadAlpine -.->|"timeout 30s"| FallbackAlpine

    classDef ok fill:#d1e7dd,stroke:#198754,color:#000
    classDef warn fill:#fff3cd,stroke:#ffc107,color:#000
    classDef err fill:#f8d7da,stroke:#dc3545,color:#000
    classDef phase fill:#cfe2ff,stroke:#0d6efd,color:#000

    class Start,Renderable ok
    class ErrDns,ErrTls,ErrSri,ErrFatal,Done301 err
    class FallbackAlpine,SriCheck,RetryLocal warn
    class HttpReq,RecvHtml,ParseDom,AlpineStart,Ready,JoinResources,InitComponents phase
